hypotheses.G1_active_high_replication: For known categories, high-active top-mode SAE-decoder mediation is at least 0.30 and exceeds low-mode mediation by at least 0.20 in both bases.
hypotheses.G2_gate_specificity: For known categories, random-active top-mode mediation exceeds random-inactive mediation by at least 0.15 in both bases.
hypotheses.G3_activation_gradient: For known categories, mediation decreases monotonically from high-active to random-active to near-threshold-inactive to random-inactive in at least one basis.
hypotheses.G4_surface_label_residual: Within random-active known-category sites, the mediation difference between surface-label positives and negatives is no more than 0.10 in at least one basis.
hypotheses.G5_known_prospective_gate_gap: Among random-active sites, known-category mediation exceeds prospective-category mediation by at least 0.10 in at least one basis.
